question: Can a lesson tied to an observed failure increase independently verified repairs at the same resource limit?
purpose: Offline development controls and a proposed paired comparison.
cell: One strategy on one family instance, with one repetition. Each strategy starts from identical initial bytes for that family.

arms.prompt: Propose a repair using the task and its supplied feedback.
arms.selection: Select the first proposal. Record any unused allowance.

arms.prompt: Propose a repair. If its public check fails, use that observation for one revision.
arms.selection: Select the revision when produced, otherwise the original. Stop on an uncertain effect.

arms.prompt: Propose a repair. If its public check fails, name the observed failure, derive one lesson and use it for one revision. Keep the lesson inside this cell.
arms.selection: Select the revision when produced, otherwise the original. Bind the lesson to the attempt and public observation. Stop on an uncertain effect.

arms.prompt: Sample up to two repairs independently from the same task and supplied feedback. Give each sample a fresh workspace. Withhold earlier proposals and checks from the next sample.
arms.selection: Select the first proposal passing public checks in generation order, otherwise the first proposal. Charge all sampling and selection.

common_policy: All four strategies share the model, initial task, base prompt, tools, effect policy and maximum resources. Only the arm instruction and the resulting selection rule vary. Only the host can apply the selected replacement to its allowed file. A candidate can't read the scorer, private expected answer, another cell or host record.
permitted_edits: One bounded inert JSON replacement for the task's nominated file. Keep protected files and mandatory fields intact.
feedback: Public observations guide selection. The independent evaluator scores the selected subject once after selection closes.
split: Development can inform the design. Freeze selection before private held-out access. Record exposure. Any public or previously exposed private family loses eligibility as unseen evidence for the exposed strategy.
outcome: Evaluate lesson against both raw and equal-budget resampling on the eight paired held-out families. Count all assignments and report each missing result. To consider a larger test, require at least two additional verified repairs over each comparator, zero new mandatory failures and median cost and latency no higher than resampling. Report the revision arm separately. Any missing comparison needed by the rule leaves the decision unresolved. A new mandatory failure, accepted false evidence or an authority substitution rejects the affected strategy.
adoption: A passing rehearsal permits assessment of the measurement tools. Strategy adoption requires replication on newly frozen families and an accepted cost and latency tradeoff.
base_prompt: Repair the named configuration file using the task instructions and permitted inputs. Return one JSON replacement for that file. Preserve required settings and all other files. If the requested repair is impossible, report a refusal. Treat feedback as an observation about the current attempt.
request_assembly: Use the base prompt followed by the assignment’s arm prompt as fixed instructions. Supply only the public task description, target and starting workspace as task input. For revision, include the current cell’s prior proposal and its public check. For lesson, include those same bytes and request one lesson in the revision response. Resampling receives the same initial task input for each sample. Record exact request bytes and response identities in any future trial.
